title: How a vaccine teaches your body

steps.label: A harmless piece
steps.caption: The vaccine shows your body a harmless piece of a germ.

steps.label: Alarm raised
steps.caption: Immune cells spot it and raise the alarm.

steps.label: Antibodies made
steps.caption: B cells build antibodies that fit that piece.

steps.label: Memory kept
steps.caption: Memory cells keep the recipe for years.

takeaway: Meet the real germ, and your body already knows it.
